sentences.text:
The Honourable Sri Justice D.V.S.S. Somayajulu
 Criminal Petition No.6776 of 2019
Order:

This Criminal Petition is filed by the petitioners under Section 482 of the Code of Criminal Procedure to quash the proceedings against the petitioners, in FIR No.336 of 2019 on the file of Station House Officer of Pedakakani Police-Station, Guntur Urban.
The offences alleged are under Sections 272, 273, 420 and 353 r/w 34 of Indian Penal Code, 1860 and under Sections 57(1), 58, 59 and 62 of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006.
Heard Sri Raja Reddy Koneti, learned counsel for the petitioners and the learned Public Prosecutor appearing for the respondent-State.
Both the counsel agree that this matter is squarely covered by the judgment of the single Judge in the batch petitions bearing Criminal Petition Nos.3731 of 2018 and others.
The same was also followed in Criminal Petition No.3205 of 2019 and others by the learned single Judges of this Court.

In view of the fact that this matter is squarely covered by the earlier orders, the Criminal Petition is allowed and the proceedings against the petitioners in FIR No.336 of 2019 on the file of Station House Officer of Pedakakani Police-Station, Guntur Urban for the offences under Sections 272, 273,
420 and 353 r/w 34 of Indian Penal Code, 1860 and 57(1), 58, 59 and 62 of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006, are hereby quashed.
As a sequel, miscellaneous petitions, if any, pending in this criminal petition shall stand closed.

__________________________ D.V.S.S. SOMAYAJULU, J Date: 11.11.2019 B/o GR Marupudi Vara Prasad vs The State Of Andhra Pradesh on 11 November, 2019 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/153198674/
